glasses_dana: Highly mobile item; location depends on time of day. Morning (9 AM): at desk_o1 (work). Evening (10 PM): at nightstand_b1 (bedroom). Previous assumption of bathroom_shelf_ba1 was incorrect for evening. Do not assume bathroom for personal items unless specifically hygiene-related. Check desk_o1 in the morning and nightstand_b1 in the evening.

water_bottle_dana: Assumed desk_o1 (work location); actually at kitchen_table_k1. Check kitchen table for hydration items during evening hours.

glass_dana: Inconsistent location tracking. At 20:47, assumed cupboard_k1 but it was at kitchen_table_k1. At 22:09, assumed kitchen_table_k1 but it was at nightstand_b1. Pattern: Glass moves between kitchen table and bedroom nightstand in the evening. Check both kitchen_table_k1 and nightstand_b1 for glass_dana after 8 PM.

book_dana: Assumed nightstand_b1; actually at couch_l1. Check living room couch for reading materials in the evening.
